findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_surfaces, create_corroboration, update_corroboration, verify_corroboration, list_corroboration_candidates, list_quests, contact_support, list_support_threads, get_support_thread · Private data: archive_tracker, create_project, update_project_canon, get_link_targets, archive_project, create_surface, tick_surface_checklist, mark_surface_aligned, list_corroborations, create_corroboration, archive_corroboration, verify_corroboration, list_corroboration_candidates, create_logbook_entry, list_quests, create_quest, update_quest, complete_quest, dismiss_quest, reopen_quest, get_usage, topup_credits, contact_support · Public sink: update_tracker, set_link_targets, list_surfaces, update_surface, tick_surface_checklist, update_corroboration, update_logbook_entry, update_quest, update_account_settings, topup_credits, contact_support · Destructive: delete_surface, delete_logbook_entry, get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_surfaces, create_corroboration, update_corroboration, verify_corroboration, list_corroboration_candidates, list_quests, contact_support, list_support_threads, get_support_thread · Private data: archive_tracker, create_project, update_project_canon, get_link_targets, archive_project, create_surface, tick_surface_checklist, mark_surface_aligned, list_corroborations, create_corroboration, archive_corroboration, verify_corroboration, list_corroboration_candidates, create_logbook_entry, list_quests, create_quest, update_quest, complete_quest, dismiss_quest, reopen_quest, get_usage, topup_credits, contact_support · Public sink: update_tracker, set_link_targets, list_surfaces, update_surface, tick_surface_checklist, update_corroboration, update_logbook_entry, update_quest, update_account_settings, topup_credits, contact_support · Destructive: delete_surface, delete_logbook_entry, get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
